summary: Issues #94/#96: builder-to-homeowner assessment proration inside the ownership transfer, and the durable builder assessment coverage record, as a GENERIC engine driven by per-community configuration. builder_assessment_programs (builder %, homeowner %, AR / income / deferral accounts, deferral release rule, accrual cadence, post-conversion accrual activation) + the community's homeowner rate row (annual assessment, assessment year end) + transfer_proration_builders. assessment_prorations ties each charge to the transfer, tenure, ledger row, batch and GL entry; transfer_proration_plan (read-only) and post_transfer_assessment_proration implement the day-based rule within the community's assessment year, read builder coverage after a posted conversion, block on ambiguous activity and only STAGE before it. Seeds the first configured community (Still Creek Ranch: its $495.00 calendar-year rate row, its program row and its builder rule). No ledger, GL, tenure or ownership row changes.

expected_changes: Creates builder_assessment_programs (one row per configured community: builder_rate_pct, homeowner_rate_pct, ar/income/deferral account numbers, deferral_release monthly_in_advance|monthly_in_arrears, accrual_cadence_months 1|3|6|12, accrual_activated_at/by, evidence). CHECKs on rates, deferral account <-> release rule, cadence, activation who+when; a guard refuses DELETE, refuses activation until the community has a POSTED conversion, and never rewrites an activation. Grants SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE to service_role. community_assessment_rates is NOT altered (it stays the one annual rate + assessment year end).
Function assessment_year_bounds(year_end_mmdd, date): the assessment year containing a date (immutable).
Creates transfer_proration_builders (community, builder company, active), PK (community_id, builder_company_id), FKs RESTRICT. Grants SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE to service_role.

assessment_prorations: adds proposal_id, role, tenure_id, period_start/end, rate_pct, net_responsibility_cents, prior_billed_cents, homeowner_txn_id, batch_id, journal_entry_id, status, staged_plan, recognition_schedule_id (FK recognition_schedules), with FKs (RESTRICT), role/status CHECKs, a completeness CHECK when tied to a transfer, and UNIQUE (proposal_id, role).
homeowner_transactions: unique index so one transfer can never carry two proration rows of the same role. No row changes.

Creates builder_assessment_coverage: the durable record of each builder tenure's billed assessment periods within the community's assessment year (year_start/year_end; filled from configuration when a writer omits them). CHECKs on period (inside its assessment year), amount = round(annual x pct x days / (100 x days_in_year)) + true-up (only on the period ending the year), origin and status; UNIQUE live period per tenure/year/start; a guard trigger refuses gaps, overlaps, mixed assessment years, a period past the tenure's end, a wrong year-end true-up, edits, deletes, and voiding anything but the last period. Functions builder_coverage_start / builder_coverage (read) are service_role only.

Functions transfer_proration_name_has (immutable), transfer_proration_plan (read-only plan, incl. the new owner's release months by covered days), post_transfer_assessment_proration (writes a draft batch + ledger rows + audit rows + the builder's transfer coverage after an approved transfer); plan/post are service_role only.

Seeds the first configured community, Still Creek Ranch: homeowner rate row $495.00 (12-31 year); program row (builder 50%, homeowner 100%, AR 1300, income 4000, deferral 2205 released monthly in advance, monthly cadence, accrual NOT activated; evidence: its own GL); the Lennar builder rule. Only if the community and builder company exist. No other row in any table changes.
